title: [Pre Order] Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 256GB $0 with Optus $69/M 36-Month Plan (in-Store Only) @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 256GB $0 with Optus $69/M 36-Month Plan (in-Store Only) @ Harvey Norman

[SwampyBits] What's 69*4? Do you cancel the plan or something?. A better description would be nice
[artcvan] That's 4 months of the plan since the Max cancellation fee goes down to 1104 after having the service for 4 months, as per CIS
[BargainsGrabber] It’s via cancellation method. The $1104/ $1264 is the maximum cancellation fee after staying for 120 days
The $69*4 is the 4 months equivalent that you need to stay
[OzSikh] I think it's 256GB that's available at $0, not 512GB. Happy to be corrected.
[OzSikh] Great post mate, you know if it is also eligible for Bonus $300 Harvey Norman Gift Card?
[nico8amy] Is this eligible for the $300 bonus gift card?
[Sygnoze] Receive a $1000 Harvey Norman Gift Card when you connect to a new OPTUS $69/mth SIM Only plan for 36 months.
https://www.harveynorman.com.au/brands/optus-mobile-data-pla…
[b0b0] Different.
There is a rotating banner in the home page of harvey norman that says $0 upfront if you connect to Optus $69 plan for 36 months.
[Masticccc] https://www.harveynorman.com.au/optus-byo#sectionVoiceSixtyF…
I think the question here is whether you can combine both the $0 upfront deal of Z Fold 8 + the $1000 gift card offers. If yes and you are buying things from Hardly Normal, then you get the Fold 8 for 380 bucks which is the most insane discount I've ever seen since covid and maybe even before lol.
On the other hand, the page said that this gift card offer is "not available with any other offers, unless specified". But given that both offers are on the same page, so one can always dream eh.
[cephh] Be warned guys, there's two variants of the fold, this model which is wider, one less camera, and the standard 'older' model which is now called Ultra.
[Tsar] I don't get why the folds need a selfie camera both on the front and on the larger unfolded screen. Wish they'd create phones without camera holes in at least one of the screens.
[CoreNex] I actually use both quite often. Front cam on the folded screen is useful for general selfies. The inner front cam on the unfold screen is useful for video calls when you need/want to see the other person in a larger format. My kid love talking to the grandparents using the inner screen.
[Masticccc] They do the UDC (under-display camera) for Fold 4 and 5 iirc, and people complaining the 5mp was too bad even for basic live video blah blah. Basically you can't satisfy the whole world, from my end I do enjoy the UDC at the cost of the camera quality as well.
[Harry Bi] Hi folks, I am really into buying a new watch ultra 2, does anyone know how to bring the price as low as we can around $500-600?
I just got a student edu price with 5% first purchase for the final pricr at $863.83
[simo1919] none for the flip 8?
for those that did JBand harvey before, does such appear on credit check history?
[b0b0] Go to the offer terms there is also another one for flip under $69 plan with lower cancellation costs
[simo1919] where do you see the optus deal? on the pages it only shows:Bonus $300 Harvey Norman Gift Card! Pre-Order Now!
edit: saw the link in the next comment
[speedyjonzalas] It would be almost impossible for this to not appear on credit history
[simo1919] would such phone offer affect a home loan approval/amount? or just present on credit history but not affect?
[Shampwho] I can’t see the z fold 8 ultra deal on the Harvey’s page ?
[tof] https://www.harveynorman.com.au/optus-byo#fold
[Mikedrop89] Never purchased a phone with plan. Can you upgrade the model to 512gb? Or is it just for the 256gb models?
[tof] I have the same question and I'm unsure.
I remember a few years back on the Pixel 8 Pro they let me pay the difference to upgrade capacity.
[simo1919] for the cancel after 4 months part, when exactly do you do it so that you don't get charged 5 months? last day of 4th month or first day of 5th month?
[Masticccc] Anytime during the 4th month, to be more precise after you paid for the 4th month fee. Regardless how early you cancel the plan, you still have all the benefits of it for the rest of that 4th month because you have already paid for it.
[cephh] And by cancelling if you're using your personal number make sure you port out, not cancel otherwise you'll just lose your number. That essentially pays out your contract.
[simo1919] how do you both cancel the plan but port out? just port out from other provider, or contact optus first?
[Mikedrop89] How does it work with pre orders? You go to HN do the paperwork, and then go back again to pick up the phone when available?
[yummypinacolada] In comparison JB + Telstra will be
ETC -$1054
1st month fee -$99
Upfront fee -$749($675 if paid by GC 10% off)
Bonus gift card +$300($270 cash value)
Total cost ~$1,558
The only way you can make it cheaper is if you are planning to go overseas soon, then with JB you can claim GST back about($245)
Making it total $1,313
HN is definitely better deal this time around than JB
[Masticccc] How do you come up with that $1054 for early cancellation fee.
[yummypinacolada] max ETC is $1100, but you've paid the first month, so its gonna be 1100*(23/24)
[Masticccc] Can you share the link of CIS on JB? Cause I actually try to look into the T&C, but the link seems to be error so I don't know where to find that max ETC.
Edit: Nevermind I found it: https://www.telstra.com.au/help/critical-information-summari… .
I guess JB is better in the way that you can choose any Fold 8 (Ultra) and Flip 8 storage model while with HN u are stuck with the smallest 256gb version. Granted that I see a comment above saying you can ask HN to upgrade the version and pay the difference, it maybe a hit or miss.
[yummypinacolada] @Masticccc: https://www.telstra.com.au/help/critical-information-summari…
[yummypinacolada] @Masticccc: Pretty sure you can upgrade by paying the difference at HN as well. It's always been like that in the past.
[Masticccc] @yummypinacolada: What's your verdict on HN $1000 gc being able to stacked on top of the 0$ front purchase? High chance or nah?
[yummypinacolada] @Masticccc: Won't happen. If you're lucky, you might get the $300 HN GC but very unlikely.
You have much better chance for negotiating a better deal with JB than HN in my experience
[simo1919] @yummypinacolada: would JB price match harvey's deal in some way?
